description: This Java class defines a custom exception named MessagePayloadSizeTooLargeException, which indicates that a message payload exceeds the maximum allowed size. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements MessageException. The class includes methods for creating instances, especially via a builder, and for deserializing from JSON. It is annotated with @Immutable and contains details about error codes, message formatting, and handling of HTTP status codes.

classes.name: MessagePayloadSizeTooLargeException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a message payload exceeds the allowed size. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements MessageException, providing static methods for instantiation and JSON deserialization, and internally uses a builder for flexible object creation.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initialized with the actual payload size and maximum allowed size.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes the exception object from a JSON representation.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified headers, preserving other properties.
